statements.markdown: The final theorem requires, for the family at each scale, a record of eleven clauses (SizeData 2 ).

lean.name: Formalism.LFunctionChainParameters.LChain.SizeData₂
lean.note: `SizeData₂` is a proposition on the slope data, constants and an auxiliary bound. Lines 17–19 list the eleven predicates side by side. In particular, `QuotientSlopeBoundsWith`, `LossBounds`, `SlopeIneq` and `DIV` supply the four displayed inequalities. `ChainTied` separately identifies the data’s scale with $x$ and requires all eleven predicates at line 109. This predicate is the conjunction of the eleven size clauses used by ChainTied.
